Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantine II (317-340), issue of 320-321, Reece period 16. Treated with oil or Vaseline. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped or mantled left. Obverse inscription: [---]NOB C. Reverse description: two captives seated under standard. Reverse inscription: [VIRTVS EXERCIT].
